title: Halo Dental mission band
description: Pure black editorial statement band: a monumental 100px headline clipped to a warm amber-to-vermilion gradient across columns 1–8, a square team/studio portrait slot beside body copy and an orange CTA in the lower-left, and a 4-column 3D canvas media slot on the right.
notes: Forces .dark so the band stays pure black (#000000) when placed on a light page
Pass teamMedia and canvasMedia props to fill the portrait square and right-hand 3D canvas slots
